short: THE MORNING ROUTINE STARTS THE DAY.
A MORNING ROUTINE CAN CHANGE THE MOOD.
WE NOTICE THE MORNING ROUTINE FIRST.
THE MORNING ROUTINE WAITS NEARBY.
A SMALL PLAN INCLUDES THE MORNING ROUTINE.
THE MORNING ROUTINE MAKES ROOM FOR REST.
GOOD DAYS OFTEN BEGIN WITH THE MORNING ROUTINE.
THE MORNING ROUTINE CONNECTS ONE MOMENT TO THE NEXT.

medium: AFTER A BUSY HOUR, THE MORNING ROUTINE BRINGS A QUIET PAUSE.
A THOUGHTFUL PERSON CAN TURN THE MORNING ROUTINE INTO A SIMPLE RITUAL.
THE MORNING ROUTINE REMINDS US THAT ORDINARY DETAILS HAVE VALUE.
WHEN PLANS CHANGE, THE MORNING ROUTINE STILL OFFERS A USEFUL ANCHOR.
SOMEONE LEFT A KIND NOTE BESIDE THE MORNING ROUTINE FOR THE NEXT VISITOR.
THE MORNING ROUTINE LOOKS DIFFERENT WHEN THE WEATHER OPENS AFTERNOON LIGHT.
A SHARED CONVERSATION MADE THE MORNING ROUTINE FEEL LIKE A FAMILIAR PLACE.
WE LEARNED SOMETHING NEW WHILE PAYING ATTENTION TO THE MORNING ROUTINE.
